quarterly_data.quarter: Evaxion Biotech press release: Evaxion reports sustained clinical responses for all (10-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Three-year follow-up of the EVX-01 Phase 2 trial in advanced melanoma: all patients maintained the clinical responses observed at two-year follow-up, with no tumor progression observed; in the third year patients received EVX-01 as stand-alone therapy (six of 12 responders continued in the one-year extension, after two years in combination with MSD's KEYTRUDA). The three-year clinical and new immune data are to be presented in a poster at ESMO 2026 on October 24, 2026. CSO and COO Birgitte Ronoe: the data add to EVX-01's package as a good foundation for potential partnership discussions.
quarterly_data.figure: all patients maintained responses at three years; no tumor progression; six of 12 responders in extension
